title: Ship a reviewed change to code you inherited
purpose: A pull request that fixes a real defect, with the test that catches it and the review thread.
why: A merged change with a review thread is the closest thing to work history a stranger can open.
evidence: Pull request URL with the review thread and the failing-then-passing test.

tasks.title: Open the pull request: the defect, the test that catches it, the fix
tasks.done_when: The test fails without your change and passes with it.

tasks.title: Take the review: answer every comment in writing, change what needs changing
tasks.done_when: Accepted, with every comment answered in the thread.
